lyrics:
[verse]
Bruno heard hit the books tonight,
He put on gloves to box and fight!
Kiki gasped, oh Bruno, no,
Those books are not your boxing foe!
[chorus]
Hit the books, hit the books,
Read and learn in quiet nooks!
Hit the books, hit the books,
Study hard is all it took!
[verse]
It means to study, read and learn,
Page by page and turn by turn,
Before a test you sit and read,
That's the kind of hit you need!
[chorus]
Hit the books, hit the books,
Read and learn in quiet nooks!
Hit the books, hit the books,
Grab a pencil, that's all it took!
[outro]
So when a test is on its way,
Hit the books, not punch, okay?
